raw.upgrade_method: npm install drizzle-orm@0.45.2 --workspace=apps/api ; npm install drizzle-kit@0.31.10 --save-dev --workspace=apps/api (explicit installs, not npm update). Only apps/api/package.json declares either package -- confirmed by grep across apps/*/package.json, packages/*/package.json, and the root package.json.
raw.npm_dist_tag_note: drizzle-kit's npm 'latest' dist-tag is 0.31.10 -- it is versioned independently of drizzle-orm (no peerDependency link between the two packages); drizzle-orm's changelog folder on GitHub has an unpublished 0.45.3 entry, but npm's published 'latest' for drizzle-orm is 0.45.2, which is also the exact version npm audit's fixAvailable pointed at for the GHSA-gpj5-g38j-94v9 advisory.

changelog_review.method: Fetched every changelogs/drizzle-orm/<version>.md file from drizzle-team/drizzle-orm on GitHub (via jsdelivr CDN raw fetch) for every version between 0.39.0 and 0.45.2 inclusive (0.38.4 is the pre-upgrade version, so 0.39.0 is the first new entry), plus changelogs/drizzle-kit/<version>.md for 0.31.0-0.31.10 (drizzle-kit was already at 0.30.6, one minor lower).

relevant_findings.item: Fixed sql.identifier() and sql.as() escaping issues -- previously values passed to these functions were not properly escaped, a SQL injection (CWE-89) vulnerability. This IS the advisory (GHSA-gpj5-g38j-94v9) driving this upgrade.
relevant_findings.action: Grepped apps/api/src and apps/api/scripts for sql.identifier( and sql.as( -- zero matches. Neither function is used anywhere in this codebase. The advisory was never reachable in Strale regardless of the upgrade; the upgrade closes it anyway since it is a direct dependency with fixAvailable pointing straight at 0.45.2.

relevant_findings.item: Introduces DrizzleQueryError, which wraps underlying driver errors (adds a proper stack trace pointing at the failing Drizzle query, the generated SQL + params, and the original driver error as a cause). Also introduces an opt-in query cache (disabled by default, global: false).
relevant_findings.action: Grepped apps/api/src for catch blocks inspecting driver-error shape after a drizzle call (error.code, error.constraint, postgres-js PostgresError checks in wallet-service.ts, x402 settlement paths, startup-migrations.ts). None of them narrow on the error's own type/identity in a way DrizzleQueryError wrapping would break -- they either check .code / .message on whatever was thrown (DrizzleQueryError exposes the original error via .cause and duck-types close enough that existing string/code checks against nested driver errors still work), or they catch-and-log generically. Confirmed no regression via the full test suite (wallet-service, x402-settlement-alerting, startup-migrations tests all pass, including the ones that specifically assert on error-swallow-then-log behavior per DEC-20260504-A rule 4). The cache feature is opt-in and never enabled anywhere in this codebase (grepped for 'cache:' passed to drizzle() calls in src/db -- not present), so it has no effect here.

relevant_findings.item: Fix wrong DrizzleQueryError export (bug in the 0.44.0 feature above, fixed two patches later).
relevant_findings.action: No action needed -- covered by taking the final 0.45.2, past this fix.
Not used -- this codebase uses drizzle-orm/postgres-js exclusively (grepped src/db for 'from "drizzle-orm/' -- only postgres-js import found).

relevant_findings.item: Gel dialect added (new database backend), 0.41.0 Bun SQL driver support, 0.39.0 Bun SQL / CTE / Neon identity additions.
relevant_findings.action: None of these dialects/drivers are used by this codebase (postgres-js only). No action.

relevant_findings.item: SQLite blob/durable-object fixes, MySQL/SingleStore join and type fixes, PlanetScale inArray ReadonlyArray support, enum TS-enum support, pg-native Pool detection fix in node-postgres transactions (not applicable -- this repo uses postgres-js, not node-postgres/pg).
relevant_findings.action: None apply to this codebase's stack (PostgreSQL via postgres-js only; no MySQL, SQLite, SingleStore, PlanetScale, node-postgres/pg driver in use).

changelog_review.not_found_in_range: No changelog entry between 0.39.0 and 0.45.2 changes: the sql template tag's own bind-parameter serialization for arrays (the ANY(${array}) row-value-tuple footgun documented in apps/api/src/lib/internal-accounts.ts stays exactly as before -- confirmed structurally by internal-accounts.test.ts, which passed unchanged), db.execute()/tx.execute() result shape (.count on UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT results, not .rowCount -- confirmed by the 184-test run across startup-migrations.test.ts + guarded-executor.test.ts + internal-accounts.test.ts + test-scheduler-skip-bumper.test.ts, and the full 3733-test suite pass), the transaction API shape (tx callback signature unchanged; wallet-service and job-coordinator tests pass), inArray() (only additive change across the whole range: 0.44.0 widened it to accept ReadonlyArray in addition to Array -- a strict widening, not a breaking change), or drizzle-kit's migration-folder / generate output shape (nothing in the drizzle-kit 0.31.0-0.31.10 changelogs touches generate/migrate/push folder or journal handling; this repo does not use drizzle-kit generate at all -- drizzle.config.ts is explicitly a test-database-bootstrap-only config that runs `drizzle-kit push --force` against an ephemeral CI Postgres from src/db/schema.ts, confirmed no apps/api/drizzle output directory exists and no migrate/generate invocation exists anywhere in package.json or .github/workflows).

drizzle_orm_audit_entry_before.advisory_title: Drizzle ORM has SQL injection via improperly escaped SQL identifiers

raw.reachability_of_the_fixed_advisory: sql.identifier() and sql.as() (the two functions the 0.45.2 patch fixed) are never called anywhere in apps/api/src or apps/api/scripts -- grep for both patterns returns zero matches. The advisory was unreachable in Strale before this upgrade; the upgrade closes the audit entry as a supply-chain hygiene fix rather than a live vulnerability remediation.

bind_shape_sweep.method: Swept apps/api/src and apps/api/scripts for db.execute(sql`...`) / tx.execute(sql`...`) (606 raw call-site matches across 87 files, 72 non-test) and for ANY(${...}) patterns (the known drizzle sql-tag array-tuple footgun documented in apps/api/src/lib/internal-accounts.ts and apps/api/src/lib/startup-migrations.ts:4875). Confirmed every ANY(${array}) call site in production code either (a) goes through the postgres package's own tag directly (jobs/quality-floor.ts, jobs/__fixtures__/*.sql, scripts/archive/* diagnostic one-offs, scripts/build-disposition.ts, scripts/session-close-check.ts, scripts/sync-known-answer-fixtures.ts -- these import `postgres` directly, not drizzle's sql, and postgres-js's own tag serializes JS arrays as a single ANY($1) bind correctly) or (b) is the documented-safe internalAccountEmailExclusionSql() helper (daily-digest/fetch-platform.ts, digest-compiler.ts, meta-monitoring.ts, reply-webhook.ts) which builds a parameterized OR-list via drizzle's sql.join() rather than interpolating a raw array. No call site interpolates a raw JS array directly into a drizzle sql`` template's ANY() -- the one shape this upgrade needed to re-verify stayed unsafe/safe identically.
bind_shape_sweep.regression_test: apps/api/src/lib/internal-accounts.test.ts structurally asserts the safe shape (a parameterized OR-list, never a single ANY(array-param) bind) by inspecting the generated SQL text and param list, independent of a live DB connection. Ran clean under drizzle-orm 0.45.2 (part of the 184-test targeted run and the 3733-test full suite).
bind_shape_sweep.postgres_js_driver_unchanged: postgres (the postgres-js driver) stayed at the exact same resolved lockfile version, 3.4.8, before and after this upgrade -- confirmed via package-lock.json diff. drizzle-orm's postgres-js adapter code changed only in ways covered by the changelog review above (none touching bind serialization); the driver itself is untouched by this batch.

migrations_and_ledger_check.result: checked 54 migration blocks in apps/api/src/lib/startup-migrations.ts -- ok. No block edited; nothing appended in this batch (no migration was needed by the upgrade -- see no_generated_migration_needed).

raw.no_generated_migration_needed: This repo's drizzle.config.ts is explicitly scoped as a 'TEST-DATABASE BOOTSTRAP ONLY' config (see its own docstring) -- CI's integration-db lane runs `drizzle-kit push --force` against an ephemeral throwaway Postgres to materialize src/db/schema.ts, and production schema changes go exclusively through hand-written, ledgered blocks in runStartupMigrations() (DEC-20260504-C). There is no committed apps/api/drizzle/ migration-output directory, and no `drizzle-kit generate` or `drizzle-kit migrate` invocation exists anywhere in package.json or .github/workflows/*.yml. The drizzle-orm/drizzle-kit version bump therefore could not have produced a generated migration to commit, and none was produced -- confirmed by `git status` showing no new files under apps/api/ other than the package.json/package-lock.json version bumps.

integration_tests_not_run_locally.reason: These files self-skip (describe.skip) unless DATABASE_URL_TEST is set. No DATABASE_URL_TEST or root .env exists in this worktree (confirmed: `ls .env` -> No such file or directory). CI's integration-db lane (.github/workflows/ci.yml) provisions an ephemeral Postgres, runs `drizzle-kit push --force` against it from src/db/schema.ts, then `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism integration.test.ts` -- this is where these files actually execute against a real drizzle-orm 0.45.2 + postgres-js 3.4.8 connection. This PR's CI run is the verification for this class of test; it was not (and could not be) run locally in this worktree.
integration_tests_not_run_locally.production_read_only_queries_owed: None identified as owed. The changelog review found no result-shape, bind-shape, transaction-API, or inArray change in the 0.39.0-0.45.2 range that this codebase's production code paths depend on differently than before (see changelog_review.not_found_in_range above), and the one advisory this upgrade fixes (sql.identifier()/sql.as() escaping) is not called anywhere in this codebase. The full local suite (3733/3733 passing, twice) plus CI's integration-db lane against a real ephemeral Postgres are the applicable verification surfaces for this batch; no root .env / DATABASE_URL was available in this worktree to run a supplementary read-only production query, and none was judged necessary given the above.
